wire.headline: Aethelgard Wind Halts Deeside Offshore Project
sentences: Aethelgard Wind has officially halted its 4.26bn GBP Deeside offshore project.
The company announced this decision on 4 November following a comprehensive board review.
CEO Marian Holt cited a 12% cost overrun as a primary factor in the cancellation.
Shares for the firm dropped 8.5% on the London Stock Exchange in response to the news.
The company has confirmed that 310m GBP in sunk costs have already been incurred.
The project had previously targeted a completion date of March 2027.
A total of 4,800 jobs are directly impacted by the cancellation of the initiative.
S&P has downgraded the bond rating to BB+ following the announcement.
